newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonia share trade sharply up, Hansa, Hoiu lead.
newsitem.headline: Estonia share trade sharply up, Hansa, Hoiu lead.

text.p: Trade on the Estonian stock exchange was sharply higher on Thursday with no big selling pressure yet seen, dealers said.
Total volume on the official list reached 99.3 million kroons of shares and the Tallinn stock exchange index continued to climb with a 2.02 percent increase to a new high of 236.11.
"It was a very busy day with lots of small deals, but some bigger blocks were traded, especially in Uhispank," said Gunnar Maemets, a securities specialist with Forekspank.
"We think the prices of most banking stocks are high, but there is still no big selling pressure," he added.
Hansapank soared by 6.00 kroons to end on 238.45 kroons. after turning over 28.1 million kroons of shares.
Hoiupank's volume was 23.7 million kroons of shares to end higher on 121.25 kroons, an increase of 3.25 kroons.
Forekspank turned over 19.7 million kroons of shares and the price powered higher by 5.35 kroons to close on 168.75 kroons.
Uhispank was saw 14.4 million kroons of shares changing hands to end 0.65 kroons higher on 46.50 kroons.
Tallinna Pank was one of the few gainers as it dropped by 0.30 kroons to finish trading on 69.70 after 8.3 million kroons of shares were traded.
Tallinna Pharma shed 3.17 kroons to close on 119 kroons on turnover of 4.8 million kroons of shares.
On the free market, 15.3 million kroons of shares were traded with diversified industrialist Norma and confectioner Kalev the most active stocks.
Kalev was 1.12 kroons higher at 1,291.12 kroons after a trade of 5.8 million kroons.
Norma firmed slightly to close on 65.60 kroons, 0.15 kroons higher on a volume of 5.6 million kroons of shares.
EMV, which earlier announced a capital increase and plans to move to the main official list, traded 1.6 million kroons and ended 125 kroons higher at 1,455 kroons.
